_provenance.spent_because: 2024-2025 were graded once already for the static cross-season question in fit_nba.py; reusing them would be test-set reuse
_provenance.metric: mean log-likelihood of the realised margin
_provenance.baseline: league-average margin and sd from the tuning seasons

multiple_testing.note: the trials were spent choosing hyperparameters on the TUNING seasons; the holdout was graded once with the chosen values, so the ceiling bounds the selection, not the grade directly. Reported because a search this size can manufacture a tuning result that then fails to replicate.

versus_static.note: the static cross-season fit measured t = -6.96 against the same kind of baseline on a different holdout; the two are not directly comparable but the sign change is the point
